node.statement: Let q=||E-I||<1. For arbitrary X put Y=(I-E)X. Idempotence gives EY=EX-E^2X=0, hence Y=(I-E)Y. Therefore ||Y||<=q||Y||, and q<1 forces Y=0. Thus (I-E)X=0 for every X, so E=I. Applied to E=Co_R using nodes 1.1 and 1.2, this gives Co_R=I_A; then def-compressed-corner gives S_R=Img(Co_R)=A.
